stem: \[xy = 12\] \[x - y = 1\] If \((x, y)\) is a solution to the system of equations above and \(x > 0\), what is the value of \(x + y\)?
solution: From the second equation, \(y = x - 1\). Substitute into the first: \(x(x - 1) = 12\), so \(x^{2} - x - 12 = 0\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sols = solve([Eq(x*y, 12), Eq(x - y, 1)], [x, y])
assert sorted(sols) == [(-3, -4), (4, 3)]
pos = [s for s in sols if s[0] > 0]
assert len(pos) == 1 and sum(pos[0]) == 7
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == 7
